title: Ensure 'Turn off multicast name resolution' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\DNS Client\Turn off multicast name resolution to 'Enabled'
reason: An attacker can listen on a network for these LLMNR (UDP/5355) broadcasts and respond to them, tricking the host into thinking that it knows the location of the requested system [7].

title: Ensure 'Configure multicast DNS (mDNS) protocol' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Network\DNS Client\Configure multicast DNS (mDNS) protocol to 'Disabled'
reason: A threat actor can listen on a network over UDP port 5353 and respond to them, tricking the host into thinking that it knows the location of the requested system [6].
